newsitem.title: USA: Fastlane Intl sets reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Fastlane Intl sets reverse stock split.

text.p: Fastlane International Enterprises Inc said Monday the company implemented a one-for-five reverse stock split effective Monday.
The company said the reverse split was approved by shareholders at a meeting on January 14. All fractional shares will be rounded up.

The company said new Fastlane common shares will be traded on the Nasdaq bulletin board under the trading symbol FSLE. Certificates for old Fastlane shares will not be accepted for transfer by Fastlane's transfer agent as of today, the company said.
Fastlane provides designing, sourcing and marketing of licensed branded products.
